title: sdd-flow-kit project configuration
description: One file per project: sdd.config.json at the repository root. The kit's skills and scripts read it. Relative paths are relative to this file.

name.description: Product name, used in generated headers.

locale.description: Language of every generated document (specs, walkthrough scripts, matrices, reports, labels). Tooling stays in English. Built-in: en, pt-BR.

baseBranch.description: Branch features start from and merge into.

root.description: Frontend source root. Scanned to find which screen calls each route.

pages.description: Folder whose page files the router maps to URLs.

router.description: How screens are discovered. 'manual': each flow lists its screens in flows.json.

framework.description: How routes are discovered. 'manual': each flow lists its routes in flows.json.

healthPath.description: Route used to read the API security headers. With framework nestjs it is read from the code; set it only to override.

docsPath.description: API documentation (Swagger), resolved against backendUrl as a URL reference: '/docs' is at the server root, 'docs' below backendUrl. Must be closed in production. With framework nestjs it is read from the code; set it only to override.

errorShape.description: Fields of an error response body. With framework nestjs it is read from the code; set it only to override.

code.description: null when the API has no error code (then only a raw message is off the catalog).

envDir.description: Folder of the backend env files (.env, .env.test). Default: the nearest folder above backend.root with a package.json.

prefix.description: Global route prefix (e.g. /api). With framework nestjs it is read from the code; set it only to override.

auth.description: How the walkthrough scripts sign in with test accounts. With framework nestjs it is read from the code; set it only to override.

loginBody.description: Login request body; {email} (or {login}, {username}) takes the account value and {password} the test password.

tokenPath.description: Dot path of the token in the login response.

cookieName.description: Cookie the frontend reads the session from (screens and captures).

commands.description: Optional. How each check runs, when the package.json scripts do not say it.

testRelated.description: Runs only the tests related to the given files (pre-commit hook).

environments.description: Optional. Without it, there is one environment per env file in backend.envDir: .env.test → test (the default when it exists), .env → local. The API URL is http://localhost:<PORT><prefix> and the frontend URL is FRONTEND_URL, both from that env file, which is the only one loaded. Use this key only for URLs no env file states.

envFile.description: Env file of this environment (default: .env for local, .env.<name> otherwise).

accounts.description: Test accounts. Never real people; the password comes from an environment variable.

source.description: Where the accounts are created (seed file). With no password key, the agent reads the password there and passes --password.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable (shell or project .env) holding the test password. Wins over accounts.password.

password.description: The test password itself, ONLY when it is a public development value (e.g. the password the seed creates). A real secret goes in passwordEnv.

roles.description: Account name → login identifier (e-mail or username). Include two accounts of the same role, to test foreign data.

testEmail.description: The only real inbox e-mails may go to during tests.

testEmailEnv.description: Environment variable (or .env entry) holding testEmail, when the address should not live in the repository.

outputDir.description: Folder of flows.json, scenarios, matrices, reports and captures. Inside the current feature folder when the project uses spec-kit (.specify/feature.json), else at the repository root.

testDataPrefix.description: Prefix of data created during a walkthrough, so it can be found and cleaned.

notFoundText.description: Text of the not-found page. Default by locale.

designSkill.description: Skill invoked on every captured screen (points 11 and 12). Optional.

domainRules.description: Project documents with domain rules a walkthrough must check (pricing, refunds, legal texts).

decisions.description: Project decisions that change how a point is judged.

dbIdsInUrl.description: 'ignore' turns the database-id part of points 14 and 16 into 🚫 (out of scope).

sentenceCase.description: Capital letter only at the start of a label (point 7).

pluralNouns.description: Plural nouns of the domain; '1 <noun>' on a screen raises plural-with-1.

toast.description: CSS selector of a floating notice (toast).

sensitiveKeys.description: Extra response keys that must never leave the API.

personKeys.description: Extra keys holding the id of a person (e.g. sellerId).

codeRules.description: Project checks added to scan-code (the ratchet: a mechanical defect found by hand becomes a rule).

onlyIn.description: Regular expression on the file path; the rule runs only where it matches.

tables.description: Optional defaults for speckit-tables when a feature filter omits them (base defaults to git.baseBranch).

base.description: Branch or commit 'touched' is measured against.
